g.text: This flow starts from an invitation for an inactive LaPrizza account.
Normal first Google sign-in without an invitation belongs to AA02.
Redirect to Google and receive callback
Browser returns to registered callback route
[Provider cancellation, missing parameters or unexpected browser state]
Show recovery guidance without API completion
[Expected state matches the initiating activation flow]
Map verified claims to domain values:
[Claims cannot be mapped to domain values]
Apply the normal AA04 response handling.
200 with session cookie, activation only, or error
Enter signed-in area, show activation, or show recovery
